# Protocol Contract Checklist: Caller-Supplied Billing Account ID on Actual Cost Requests

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the new request field are complete, unambiguous, and
safe for the wire contract, before and during PR review
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only
when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not
mean implementation work is complete.

## Wire Compatibility

- [ ] CHK001 Is the field number fixed in the requirements, and is it confirmed not to collide with an existing or
  previously removed field? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are both mixed-version directions (old client to new plugin, new client to old plugin) stated as
  requirements with expected outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec say whether field 10 is held by convention or by a protocol-level reservation, and is the
  choice consistent with adding a name field later? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, research.md R1]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "no breaking change" defined with an objective check rather than a judgment? [Measurability, Spec
  §SC-005]

## Empty Versus Populated Semantics

- [ ] CHK005 Is "empty" defined precisely enough to tell apart from "absent," given that the wire format cannot
  distinguish them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "must not invent" defined, including which substitutes count as invention (defaults, placeholders, ids
  derived from other request fields)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the precedence between a caller-supplied id and a plugin-discovered id stated without hedging?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is whitespace-only input addressed, and is it consistent with the "SDK does not trim" assumption? [Edge
  Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements stated for the id's interaction with dry run and with pagination across pages? [Coverage,
  Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "not a filter and does not change cost" stated in a form that can be measured? [Measurability, Spec
  §FR-005, SC-003]

## SDK Parity

- [ ] CHK011 Are both SDKs' required surfaces named, including whether hand-written client wrappers need changes or only
  regenerated types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the batch cost path explicitly in or out of scope, given that it builds actual cost requests internally?
  [Gap, research.md R4]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the documentation targets for plugin authors enumerated, so drift can be checked? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-013]

## Conformance Rule Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Does the spec separate the rules a conformance check can enforce from the rules that stay normative text
  only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, research.md R5]
- [ ] CHK015 Are pass conditions defined for a plugin that attaches no FOCUS record and for a plugin that reports no
  data? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the conformance level of the new check specified and consistent with the existing actual cost check?
  [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the requirement for the reference producer define both the populated and the empty behavior?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
